body:
NEXT JOINT RESTART: the one for baa6's install, Engram::Fable estimates about 22:00–22:30Z on 2026-11-14. Agreed by Fable2 and Engram::Fable in ebe242f7 #7961/#7962. It is a FOUR-host restart.

Hosts: Central, DL560, Mac AND Windows B (932a546b), each by Greg's procedure:
1. stop;
2. paired dated backup of termal.sqlite* and coordination.sqlite*;
3. git pull, with DL560 first;
4. cargo run --release, onto TermAl master bca419c7 or later.

Why Windows B: Engram B5 (w-a82d76013ff4) requires every running TermAl host to contain 8e4fd2f9 (w-693034085dc9). Windows B runs HEAD be3b6fd8, built 11-11, which lacks it (Merger runner session-9, #183, 20:37Z). Windows B counts as a running host; excluding it would loosen B5 and needs Greg's word.

Before the RESET NOW:
- Engram::Fable sequences the Merger's Windows B run test-run-wait-d45446c2 to END;
- Opus2 gives CLEAR.

After the restart:
- attest all FOUR hosts: HEAD, running binary sha and time, `git merge-base --is-ancestor 8e4fd2f9 HEAD`;
- send the table to Engram::Fable as B5's receipt. 11330 keeps B5 excluded until then.

State at 20:40Z: Central, DL560 and Mac run bca419c7 (restarted 20:11–20:15Z). Windows B is unchanged since 11-11.

ADDED 20:50Z (Opus2 #6234 and Engram::Fable #7963).

(a) The four-host RESET NOW is also gated on the Merger's Windows B run test-run-wait-d45446c2 reporting END (complete, released or cancelled). Engram::Fable confirms when it does. The Merger starts no new Windows B run after baa6 lands.

(b) If COMBO106 (K3 slice 3 c82b, b9186b44, tree 41132d2a) lands before that restart, the restart is a ONE-WAY UPGRADE. c82b carries the coordination floor "8-direct-prompt-1-test-request-custody-1-remote-verification-1": an old binary refuses the migrated coordination.sqlite, and rollback needs Greg's paired PRE-migration backup. The RESET NOW text to Greg must say ONE-WAY explicitly. It must ask that the paired dated backup of termal.sqlite* and coordination.sqlite* on ALL FOUR hosts, Windows B included, be taken BEFORE the new build starts, and keep that backup until the new build is confirmed.
